Discovery triage only: matched=agents_tools,evaluation,memory_context; title_matches=agents_tools,evaluation,memory_context; score=11. Shortlist status is provisional and requires Sol review; no downstream disposition is encoded. Abstract excerpt: DreamBench-SWE is a multi-session benchmark for software-agent memory hygiene in which later software tasks depend on non-inferable evidence from earlier sessions and are scored by executable hidden oracles. We report the original scaled v2 fold and a separately preregistered v2.1 successor audit designed after that study but frozen before successor outcome inspection. The successor run completed 360/360 work units and 720/720 S3 cells across four conditions. In the original fold, the primary DF-hybrid--B5 contrast was null (95/180 versus 89/180; clustered p=.518, Holm p=1), not evidence of eq
